# Fetch each playlist's songs and identify matches against archive_songs.
# Need to map artist_ids to artist names.
matches = []  # list of (playlist_id, song_id, title, artist_name)
for pl in all_playlists:
    detail = apis.spotify.show_playlist(playlist_id=pl['playlist_id'], access_token=spotify_token)
    for song in detail.get('songs', []):
        # Get artist names
        artist_names = []
        for aid in song.get('artist_ids', []):
            artist = apis.spotify.show_artist(artist_id=aid)
            artist_names.append(artist['name'])
        # Use first artist as primary
        primary_artist = artist_names[0] if artist_names else ''
        if (song['title'], primary_artist) in archive_songs:
            matches.append((pl['playlist_id'], song['id'], song['title'], primary_artist))
print(len(matches))
for m in matches:
    print(m)
